what: Masked video to video, second clip (owner, 2026-10-04): 1:35 to 2:07 of a six-person band video with coloured lighting changes and cutaways, the lead singer replaced from the same reference still as bench/masked_v2v_arms.json, on the clip-agnostic prompt for a subject among other people. The tracker's phrase and object selection were chosen from probes: tracking every person spends the object cap before the main shot, and the phrase 'lead singer' also takes the most prominent person of each cutaway, so the three objects that are the lead are selected by index. The indices hold only for this loader start, frame cap and phrase. Later the same day, on the reference still with its watermark sparkle cloned out by a peer session (the original still, which band_generic_32s used, has been withdrawn by the owner, so that arm cannot be re-run as written). band_head_w1: the node's `replace` set to head and hair, first window, on the clip-agnostic head prompt; the first attempt at this regenerated the head-and-hair outline alone and gave a head half as wide again as the original's ('a giant bobblehead', owner), so the node now regenerates the subject down to where the hair ends. band_follows_32s: whole subject on a clip-agnostic prompt that takes his facing, his movement and his clothes from the people beside him, to see whether he turns with the group unprompted. band_changed_w1: whole subject on the plain clip-agnostic group prompt, first window, with the composite that keeps only what changed and the mask grown twice as far; the reference for band_baseline_w1, which is the same on the baseline chain (the undistilled checkpoint at the base step count, stock attention, no Sol), built from the generator's own builder and kept under internal/ because no shipped graph is on that chain (owner: try without Sol and without the distill, both, first). band_subject_w1 is the first arm on the shipped graph after it moved to the pack's Subject Track node (owner, 2026-10-04: two nodes, and make it the shipped workflow): the lead is picked as the largest person on one frame of the warm group shot and followed across the cuts, with no typed object indices; the margin and the composite are the node's defaults. Every arm above this one names nodes the shipped graph no longer has (the phrase encoder, core's tracker and track-to-mask), so they are the record of what rendered on the graph as it stood at fc2628f9 and do not run on the current one. turn_control is one window from 1:52, which holds the shot where the group turns away, on the shipped graph and the generic group prompt. Its two siblings in the record, turn_late1 and turn_late2, are the same arm on a copy of the shipped graph with core's SplitSigmas between the schedule and the song node, dropping the first one or two knots so the sampler starts from a partly noised source; those copies were built by hand and are not in the tree, so the rows are their record. band_auto_w1 is band_subject_w1 with nothing set on the tracker, after the Subject Track took its pick frame, match and cuts automatically: the validation of that node through the shipped graph.
